none: PAS KENT-FB0391: 7th century Anglo-Saxon Tremissis, 'Pada' type
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete early-medieval/Anglo-Saxon 'pale' gold sceat of Transitional/Pre-Primary Phase Series PaIII, dating c.675-680. Ref: Metcalf 1993: 76-7. The reverse inscription ([NOVI] (runic pada) ANVSPFAV) is typical of the earlier pale gold varieties of PaIII (later varieties devolve to a series of mostly A and V).
